definitions.explanation: Going from bar to bar drinking, or making a habit of going out to drink. The noun form of {飲|の}み{歩|ある}く.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}の{飲|の}み{歩|ある}きが{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: I look forward to bar-hopping on the weekend.

examples.japanese: {昨夜|ゆうべ}は{飲|の}み{歩|ある}きで{散財|さんざい}してしまった。
examples.english: I spent way too much money bar-hopping last night.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}は、{毎晩|まいばん}のように{友達|ともだち}と{飲|の}み{歩|ある}きをしていた。
examples.english: When I was young, I would go out drinking with friends almost every night.

notes:
The noun form of the compound verb {飲|の}み{歩|ある}く ({飲|の}む to drink + {歩|ある}く to walk), meaning to go around from bar to bar drinking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲|の}み{歩|ある}きをする: to go bar-hopping
- {夜|よる}の{飲|の}み{歩|ある}き: a night of bar-hopping

SIMILAR WORDS:
- はしご{酒|ざけ}: bar-hopping — emphasizes visiting several bars in sequence in one night
- {飲|の}み{会|かい}: drinking party — a single organized gathering, not moving around
